title: CommonContracts
$comment: Shared value objects for the whole platform. Time is RFC3339 UTC only; user/billing time zones live in separate IANA-name fields. Internal resource ids are UUIDs; source ids stay verbatim plus a namespace.

Rfc3339UtcTimestamp.title: Rfc3339UtcTimestamp
Rfc3339UtcTimestamp.description: RFC3339 instant normalized to UTC. Only the literal 'Z' offset is accepted; a separate IanaTimeZone field carries the user/billing zone.

IanaTimeZone.title: IanaTimeZone
IanaTimeZone.description: IANA time zone name (e.g. Asia/Shanghai). Stored separately from instants so no local-offset arithmetic happens on the wire.

Uuid.title: Uuid
Uuid.description: Canonical lowercase UUID identifying an internal platform resource.

DecimalString.title: DecimalString
DecimalString.description: Exact decimal rendered as a string. Exponent notation and JSON numbers are rejected so money and physical quantities never lose precision in billing paths.

UnitCode.title: UnitCode
UnitCode.description: Canonical unit token (e.g. kWh, kW, Wh, W, %).

Sha256Digest.title: Sha256Digest
Sha256Digest.description: Content integrity digest. Algorithm is prefixed so the digest scheme can evolve without ambiguity.

Namespace.title: Namespace
Namespace.description: Lowercase dotted-free namespace owned by an industry pack or adapter.

OpaqueCursor.title: OpaqueCursor
OpaqueCursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Clients must echo it verbatim and never parse it.

DecimalQuantity.title: DecimalQuantity
DecimalQuantity.description: Physical quantity with an exact decimal amount and a canonical unit. Never a JSON float.

Money.title: Money
Money.description: Exact monetary amount plus ISO 4217 currency. Billing never uses a JSON float.

VersionRef.title: VersionRef
VersionRef.description: Reference to a published, immutable artifact (component, industry pack, policy, schema, operation).

ResourceRef.title: ResourceRef
ResourceRef.description: Reference to an internal platform resource. Internal resources use UUID ids; digests pin the exact immutable revision.

SourceRef.title: SourceRef
SourceRef.description: Source-system identity: the native id is kept verbatim and disambiguated by namespace instead of being rewritten into a canonical id.

SourceObjectRef.title: SourceObjectRef
SourceObjectRef.description: A physical source object (table/view/collection/entity/metric) addressed only through the mapping layer.

ScopeRef.title: ScopeRef
ScopeRef.description: Tenant/space scope boundary. Every entity id, version and FK is scoped by this.

Principal.title: Principal
Principal.description: Trusted subject identity established by the server (OIDC/JWKS in production, loopback-only local-dev principal in development). Never taken from model or tool arguments.

authEpoch.description: Monotonic authorization epoch. Bumping it invalidates previously issued delegations and tool contexts.

ConsistencyLevel.title: ConsistencyLevel
ConsistencyLevel.description: Snapshot consistency actually offered by a backend. repeatable_read is only valid inside the originating transaction; it must never be advertised as a permanently re-readable version.

DataMode.title: DataMode
DataMode.description: INV-10: simulation, real observation, forecast and device execution state are explicit contract values, never distinguished by UI copy.

CompletenessStatus.title: CompletenessStatus
CompletenessStatus.description: Completeness of a retrieval over a declared scope. A truncated recall range never proves that nothing else exists.

DomainResultStatus.title: DomainResultStatus
DomainResultStatus.description: Domain-level outcome. Kept separate from tool execution failure: infeasible can be a successful computation, and no-match evidence does not make a proposition false.

Integrity.title: Integrity
Integrity.description: Integrity proof for a stored artifact or evidence payload.

RevisionString.title: RevisionString
RevisionString.description: Monotonic revision rendered as a decimal string so large integers survive JavaScript number precision.
